name: iii-observe
description: Use when one iii function should run when another runs (iii.observe), when binding functions to HTTP routes, cron schedules, queue topics, state or database changes, or engine events through their source functions (http::on-request, cron::on-tick, queue::on-message, state::on-changed, database::on-row-changed), when writing filters, or when writing an event source with onObserverAdded, onObserverRemoved, onObservationMatch, and onObservationDeliver across TypeScript, browser, Python, Rust, and Go.
